stateStrip.pulseHelpRich: Pulse turns recent workspace activity into a simple workload cue. <steady>Steady</steady> means the pace looks manageable; <attend>Attend</attend> means load is elevated—pause before you pile on more; <intervene>Intervene</intervene> means it is a good moment to slow down, cut context switching, or take a short break.
stateStrip.pulseHelpDisclaimer: Your header shows the same level for quick context. Pulse is for productivity awareness only—not a medical or clinical assessment.
stateStrip.flowHelpP1: Three review-only scores inferred from workspace rhythm: messages, queues, Sun glow, and recent dashboard actions—not physiology.
stateStrip.flowFootnote: Roughly 0–100 each · Refines when your snapshot is processed · Not clinical

dashboard.title: Well-being
dashboard.wishlistPopoverBody: Save links you like—we pull title and price when possible. Agents can use them for gifting context. Editing the list is free; running Gift Suggester uses credits.
dashboard.baselineBirthday: Birthday-based lighting. Add location in Settings for weather-aware golden hour.
dashboard.baselineRough: Rough lighting until you add birthday or location in Settings.

lunar.collapsibleHint: Holidays, local events, and photo-spot tools live in the expanded cosmic calendar. We keep this view quiet so your rhythm stays readable.

mood.embeddedHelpP1: Inbox, protocols, queue, goals, glow, dashboard activity · UTC · review-only—you don't type these scores.
mood.embeddedHelpP2: Energy is this browser session: it falls over ~5 hours while this tab stays visible, refills slowly when you hide the tab or step away, and resets to full at local midnight.
mood.cardSubtitle: Inbox, queues, goals, glow, light engagement · UTC · review-only

creatorMoodPulse.title: Mood pulse (constellation check-in)
creatorMoodPulse.description: A quick non-clinical game: pick up to three emojis, slide your energy, add a line if you want—then get a grounded ritual for the next hour.
